g.text: REFERENCE RENDER (ISO2) — rendered off this solid,
1. ALL DIMENSIONS IN mm AND DEGREES. EVERY DIMENSION AND
EVERY HOLE CALLOUT WAS MEASURED OFF THE SOLID.
3. THINNEST WALL, WHOLE SOLID: 1.0000 mm, AT X=-27.402
Y=-6.099 Z=16.500 — MEASURED OVER THE WHOLE SOLID BY
RAY+EXACT AT 1.409 mm SAMPLE SPACING (A FEATURE
NARROWER THAN THAT CAN BE MISSED). A RAY MINIMUM AT AN
EDGE, A FILLET RUN-OUT OR A CHAMFER TIP IS A REAL
DISTANCE THROUGH MATERIAL AND IS NOT A PRINTABLE WALL.
4. GENERAL TOLERANCE CANNOT DETERMINE — SEE PRINT / DFM
5. SECTION A-A AT Y=20.50: THINNEST MATERIAL IN THIS PLANE
ONLY 1.00 mm, AT X=-28.02, Z=17.00 — A SCAN OF ONE CUT,
6. TOP VIEW: hidden lines KEPT: without them 36 of 690
edge samples have no ink within 0.35 mm (worst 2.342
mm) and the feature would be missing from the sheet.
7. FRONT VIEW: hidden lines SUPPRESSED: all 658 edge
samples still land on drawn ink without them.
1. ORIENTATION: laid flat (57 x 36 x 3 mm)
4. TOLERANCE BASIS, IN-HOUSE: CANNOT DETERMINE. Every
Bambu on this farm records tolerance_mm: null, cite "no
coupon printed and measured on this machine"
Bambu Lab's own H2D Pro spec sheet carries no
dimensional-accuracy line. DIMENSIONS HERE ARE NOMINAL
5. TOLERANCE BASIS, OUTSOURCED: JLC3DP +/-0.3 mm FDM
ce-machines/farm-hubs). Apply the route's figure, not
both. The +/-0.2 mm in cecad/machining.py fdm is a repo
planning constant with no vendor cite and is NOT used
here. One printed and measured coupon closes this note.
6. NO ISO 286 CLASS IS DECLARED ON ANY BORE: FDM cannot be
sized to one (H7/p6 at O3 is a 0.010 mm band). REAM
bearing and press-fit bores after printing.
every row measured off the solid; positions are model
coordinates, mm. C'BORE side is the face it opens on.
